author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing DITRA-HEAT mats using thin-set mortar and run the heat cable in the mats. I use two floor sensors, one is a backup, and tile directly over everything. There are a lot of steps to any heated floor, so I created a step-by-step course to help you out at homerepairtutor.com
title: Heated Tile Floor Installation Tips - #shorts #heatedfloor #bathroomrenovation
